images.layout: Two equal square cells, neutral left and approval right, transparent PNG
images.prompt: Create a transparent PNG game dialogue portrait expression sheet. Input 1 defines the character identity and outfit. Input 2 defines clean cel shaded anime linework and layout only. Wide 2:1 canvas with TWO EQUAL SQUARE CELLS. Same waist-up pose repeated, LEFT attentive neutral expression, RIGHT warm approving smile. Whole head and hat, shoulders, hands contained inside each cell with 8 percent transparent margins at top and sides; only waist cropped. No lettering, background scene, extra characters or borders. Clear line art and restrained cel shadows, consistent with the reference game's portraits. Leon, Galar champion: long spiky purple hair, warm brown skin, amber eyes, black cap with gold crown motif, black sports shirt with sword crest, royal red cape with cream fur edging. Confident welcoming posture, one gloved hand near waist. His joyful competitive spirit, not arrogance.
